history.name: A file named for the client and the version
history.description: The edition is written out under a name built from the product and its version number, so a client with several of them on a desktop can tell one from another without opening any. The pattern can be changed per project.
history.dev_notes: config.output.pdf_name with {slug} and {version}; titleSlug() keeps the product's capitals and collapses only spaces.
